summary: Case case-003 (s.demir@aegean.edu): escalate, confidence 0.51. F1 confirms 8 suspicious sign-ins from Cloudvault VPS (DE), outside the account baseline ASN {T1078.004}. F2 confirms VPN appliance vpn-edge-01 (firmware 22.7R2.3) runs a product with CISA KEV-listed CVEs including CVE-2026-104935, CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282 {T1133,T1190}. Risk Gate: sign-in path touches an exposed asset; partial chain with 0 abuse + 1 access signal; DQ vpn_session_order failing for appliance:vpn-edge-01; signals of compromise without a confirmed abuse chain.

risk.rationale: Case is not a confirmed account takeover chain (F1 suspicious sign-ins at 0.52 confidence are not confirmed takeover, and F2 only shows a CISA KEV-listed vulnerable VPN appliance, not confirmed exploitation), so contain does not apply. Signals are not explained away (no rejected claims), so benign does not apply. The situation exceeds a weak unexplained signal: there is active exposure (vpn-edge-01 on KEV-listed firmware with multiple CVEs) plus conflicting/insufficient evidence (DQ vpn_session_order failing), which prevents correlating the 8 non-baseline Cloudvault VPS sign-ins to VPN sessions. Exposure combined with conflicting/insufficient evidence requires human review → escalate.
